articles.fullText:
John Ternus (L) and Tim Cook at the premiere of Apple TV's "Ted Lasso" season 4 at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles, California, US, July 27, 2026. 
Apple Inc.'s leadership transition officially took effect on Tuesday, with John Ternus succeeding Tim Cook as chief executive officer and Cook becoming executive chairman of the company's board of directors.
Apple's updated leadership page now lists Ternus as CEO and a member of the board, while Cook is now listed as executive chair.
Apple announced the succession plan on April 20, saying the transition had been unanimously approved by its board and followed a long-term succession planning process. Cook remained CEO through the summer and worked closely with Ternus on the transition. As executive chairman, Cook will continue to assist with certain aspects of the company, including engagement with policymakers around the world.
Tim Cook (R) walks with John Ternus at the Allen & Company Sun Valley Conference at the Sun Valley Lodge in Sun Valley, Idaho, US, July 7, 2026. 
Cook, who joined Apple in 1998, became CEO in 2011 and led the company for about 15 years. During his tenure, Apple introduced new product categories including Apple Watch, AirPods and Apple Vision Pro, as well as services ranging from iCloud and Apple Pay to Apple TV and Apple Music.
Apple said in April that under Cook's leadership, its market capitalization had grown from approximately $350 billion to $4 trillion, while annual revenue had risen from $108 billion in fiscal 2011 to more than $416 billion in fiscal 2025.
In a public letter to the Apple community, Cook reflected on his 15 years as CEO and said the transition was "not goodbye." He described Ternus as a brilliant engineer and thinker who had spent 25 years helping build Apple products.
Ternus joined Apple's product design team in 2001, became a vice president of Hardware Engineering in 2013 and joined the executive team as senior vice president of Hardware Engineering in 2021.
He has overseen hardware engineering across a range of Apple products and played a key role in the introduction of iPad and AirPods, as well as multiple generations of iPhone, Mac and Apple Watch.
In his April statement, Ternus said he had spent almost his entire career at Apple, had worked under Steve Jobs and had Cook as his mentor. He pledged to lead the company according to the values and vision that have defined Apple for half a century.
Apple disclosed in a filing on Tuesday that Ternus' base salary was increased to $3 million, the same as Cook's salary as CEO. There will also be an annual equity award with a $55 million target value, starting 2027, a majority of which will be tied to the company's stock performance.
Cook, meanwhile, will earn $2 million annually, effective September 26, and restricted stock units in 2027 with a target value of $45 million. His total compensation for 2025 exceeded $74 million.
AI a big challenge
Artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to be one of Ternus' biggest challenges, as Apple has faced criticism for falling behind rivals in introducing advanced AI features, including delays in upgrading Siri with more powerful capabilities.
"AI is the single biggest challenge for Ternus. Apple needs to demonstrate that AI will be more than an app on the iPhone, more than Siri," said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, which owns Apple stock.
The September 9 iPhone event will be the first public measure of the handover. A foldable iPhone would be the most significant redesign in years, and Ternus will be its face – only eight days after taking over the position.

articles.title: Western allies step up pressure on Israel over West Bank settlements
articles.titleCn: 西方盟友就约旦河西岸定居点问题加大对以色列施压
articles.summary: Israel's expanding settlement activity and rising settler violence in the occupied West Bank have fueled growing concern among its Western allies and renewed calls for a two-state solution.
articles.summaryCn: 英国、法国、加拿大等西方盟友发表联合声明，谴责以色列在约旦河西岸的定居点扩张和定居者暴力，并宣布对以色列定居点商品实施贸易限制，以保护两国方案。

paragraphs.en:
Israel's {{0}} settlement activity and rising settler violence in the {{1}} West Bank have fueled growing {{2}} among its Western allies and renewed calls for a two-state solution. The leaders of Britain, France and Canada issued a joint statement on Tuesday {{3}} their "{{4}} to protect the two-state solution" in the face of the "{{5}} {{6}}" of Israeli settlements in the West Bank. "A two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is {{7}} for peace, {{8}} and security in the Middle East and beyond," and the settlements "pose a direct and {{9}} {{10}} to that vision for peace," British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, French President Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said in the joint statement. "Settlements are illegal under international law," they said, {{11}} the Israeli government's decision to progress the E1 settlement, and the "{{12}} increase in settler violence."
Also on Tuesday, the foreign ministers of 12 countries, including the UK, Canada and France, issued a joint statement announcing the introduction of {{13}} on trade in goods with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. "Today, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Sweden and the UK confirm their intention to introduce national and/or support European restrictions on trade in goods with settlements which are illegal under international law, or that they are actively considering these and other measures, in accordance with their national procedures," the nations' foreign ministers said in a joint statement. The situation in the West Bank is rapidly {{14}} amid {{15}} levels of settler violence and settlement expansion, said the statement, adding that France, the UK and Canada will propose national-level measures to ban trade in goods with settlements. French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said on Tuesday that France will launch a process to ban products from Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
paragraphs.cn: 以色列不断扩大的定居点活动和在被占领的约旦河西岸不断升级的定居者暴力，引发了其西方盟友日益增长的担忧，并再次呼吁实现两国方案。英国、法国和加拿大领导人周二发表联合声明，面对以色列在约旦河西岸定居点的“系统性扩张”，重申他们“保护两国方案的承诺”。英国首相安迪·伯纳姆、法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和加拿大总理马克·卡尼在联合声明中表示：“以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的两国方案对中东及更广泛地区的和平、稳定与安全至关重要”，而定居点“对这一和平愿景构成直接而紧迫的威胁”。他们表示：“根据国际法，定居点是非法的”，并谴责以色列政府推进E1定居点的决定，以及“定居者暴力的急剧增加”。同样在周二，包括英国、加拿大和法国在内的12个国家的外长发表联合声明，宣布对与被占领约旦河西岸以色列定居点的商品贸易实施限制。这些国家的外长在联合声明中表示：“今天，加拿大、丹麦、芬兰、法国、冰岛、爱尔兰、挪威、波兰、葡萄牙、西班牙、瑞典和英国确认，他们打算根据本国程序，推出本国和/或支持欧洲对与根据国际法属于非法的定居点进行商品贸易的限制，或者他们正在积极考虑这些及其他措施。”声明称，在定居者暴力和定居点扩张达到前所未有的程度之际，约旦河西岸局势正在迅速恶化，并补充说法国、英国和加拿大将提出国家层面的措施，禁止与定居点进行商品贸易。法国外长让-诺埃尔·巴罗周二表示，法国将启动禁止以色列在约旦河西岸定居点产品的程序。

paragraphs.en:
"France is going to put an end to its commerce with Israeli settlements in Palestine, along with 11 other countries which have also undertaken similar engagements," Barrot wrote on X. France maintains that Israel must {{16}} settlement expansion and associated violence, Barrot said, adding that France cannot support, through trade, a situation that threatens the safety of Israelis and Palestinians as well as regional peace and stability. He also called on the European Union to take appropriate measures. The latest push for tougher measures followed Israel's advancement of the E1 settlement project in the West Bank in August by issuing a tender for 1,234 housing units. According to a tender published online by Israel's Ministry of Construction and Housing, the project covers part of a broader plan to build 3,401 housing units in the E1 area east of Jerusalem. The 12 foreign ministers said the E1 decision was among the developments undermining prospects for a Palestinian state and called on the Israeli government to immediately halt settlement expansion and ensure {{17}} for settler violence. Israeli President Isaac Herzog criticized the planned British move on Tuesday, calling sanctions a "grave miscalculation."
Meanwhile, Palestinian Vice President Hussein al-Sheikh said on Tuesday that the measures were a "step in the right direction," while calling for binding international action to halt illegal settlement expansion and the de facto annexation of the West Bank.
paragraphs.cn: 巴罗在X上写道：“法国将终止与以色列在巴勒斯坦定居点的商业往来，另有11个国家也做出了类似承诺。”巴罗表示，法国坚持认为以色列必须停止定居点扩张及相关暴力，并补充说法国不能通过贸易支持一种威胁以色列人和巴勒斯坦人安全以及地区和平与稳定的局面。他还呼吁欧盟采取适当措施。此前，以色列于8月通过为1，234套住房单元发布招标，推进了约旦河西岸的E1定居点项目，从而引发了最新一轮要求采取更严厉措施的呼声。根据以色列建设和住房部在网上发布的招标文件，该项目是耶路撒冷以东E1地区建造3，401套住房单元更广泛计划的一部分。12国外长表示，E1决定是破坏巴勒斯坦建国前景的事态发展之一，并呼吁以色列政府立即停止定居点扩张，确保对定居者暴力追究责任。以色列总统伊萨克·赫尔佐格周二批评了英国计划采取的举措，称制裁是“严重的误判”。与此同时，巴勒斯坦副总统侯赛因·谢赫周二表示，这些措施是“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”，同时呼吁采取具有约束力的国际行动，以停止非法定居点扩张和对约旦河西岸的事实吞并。

articles.fullText:
Israel's expanding settlement activity and rising settler violence in the occupied West Bank have fueled growing concern among its Western allies and renewed calls for a two-state solution.
The leaders of Britain, France and Canada issued a joint statement on Tuesday affirming their "commitment to protect the two-state solution" in the face of the "systematic expansion" of Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
"A two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is critical for peace, stability and security in the Middle East and beyond," and the settlements "pose a direct and urgent threat to that vision for peace," British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, French President Emmanuel Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said in the joint statement.
"Settlements are illegal under international law," they said, condemning the Israeli government's decision to progress the E1 settlement, and the "dramatic increase in settler violence."
Also on Tuesday, the foreign ministers of 12 countries, including the UK, Canada and France, issued a joint statement announcing the introduction of restrictions on trade in goods with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
"Today, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Sweden and the UK confirm their intention to introduce national and/or support European restrictions on trade in goods with settlements which are illegal under international law, or that they are actively considering these and other measures, in accordance with their national procedures," the nations' foreign ministers said in a joint statement.
The situation in the West Bank is rapidly deteriorating amid unprecedented levels of settler violence and settlement expansion, said the statement, adding that France, the UK and Canada will propose national-level measures to ban trade in goods with settlements.
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said on Tuesday that France will launch a process to ban products from Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
"France is going to put an end to its commerce with Israeli settlements in Palestine, along with 11 other countries which have also undertaken similar engagements," Barrot wrote on X.
France maintains that Israel must halt settlement expansion and associated violence, Barrot said, adding that France cannot support, through trade, a situation that threatens the safety of Israelis and Palestinians as well as regional peace and stability. He also called on the European Union to take appropriate measures.
The latest push for tougher measures followed Israel's advancement of the E1 settlement project in the West Bank in August by issuing a tender for 1,234 housing units.
According to a tender published online by Israel's Ministry of Construction and Housing, the project covers part of a broader plan to build 3,401 housing units in the E1 area east of Jerusalem.
The 12 foreign ministers said the E1 decision was among the developments undermining prospects for a Palestinian state and called on the Israeli government to immediately halt settlement expansion and ensure accountability for settler violence.
Israeli President Isaac Herzog criticized the planned British move on Tuesday, calling sanctions a "grave miscalculation."
Meanwhile, Palestinian Vice President Hussein al-Sheikh said on Tuesday that the measures were a "step in the right direction," while calling for binding international action to halt illegal settlement expansion and the de facto annexation of the West Bank.

以色列不断扩大的定居点活动和在被占领的约旦河西岸不断升级的定居者暴力，引发了其西方盟友日益增长的担忧，并再次呼吁实现两国方案。英国、法国和加拿大领导人周二发表联合声明，面对以色列在约旦河西岸定居点的“系统性扩张”，重申他们“保护两国方案的承诺”。英国首相安迪·伯纳姆、法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和加拿大总理马克·卡尼在联合声明中表示：“以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的两国方案对中东及更广泛地区的和平、稳定与安全至关重要”，而定居点“对这一和平愿景构成直接而紧迫的威胁”。他们表示：“根据国际法，定居点是非法的”，并谴责以色列政府推进E1定居点的决定，以及“定居者暴力的急剧增加”。同样在周二，包括英国、加拿大和法国在内的12个国家的外长发表联合声明，宣布对与被占领约旦河西岸以色列定居点的商品贸易实施限制。这些国家的外长在联合声明中表示：“今天，加拿大、丹麦、芬兰、法国、冰岛、爱尔兰、挪威、波兰、葡萄牙、西班牙、瑞典和英国确认，他们打算根据本国程序，推出本国和/或支持欧洲对与根据国际法属于非法的定居点进行商品贸易的限制，或者他们正在积极考虑这些及其他措施。”声明称，在定居者暴力和定居点扩张达到前所未有的程度之际，约旦河西岸局势正在迅速恶化，并补充说法国、英国和加拿大将提出国家层面的措施，禁止与定居点进行商品贸易。法国外长让-诺埃尔·巴罗周二表示，法国将启动禁止以色列在约旦河西岸定居点产品的程序。

articles.fullText:
An Iranian tanker was hit by US forces on Saturday near Iran's key oil export hub, Kharg Island, in the Gulf, the semi-official Iranian news agency Tasnim reported.
According to a Tasnim correspondent from Kharg, the tanker was hit by four US missiles in the area of Kharg Island's anchorage.
Four projectiles fired by US forces struck the tanker about 10 kilometers off the coast of Kharg Island, the report said.
Tasnim quoted local sources as saying there were no casualties and the tanker's crew was being evacuated.
The reported incident came after the US and Iran exchanged attacks in recent days, ending roughly a month of relative calm. US forces resumed strikes on Iranian targets last week, while Iran responded with missile and drone attacks on US positions and other targets in the Gulf.
The escalation has also increasingly affected commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said earlier this week that two oil tankers had struck mines in the strait after attempting to use what Tehran described as an unauthorized route. The US military disputed the claim, saying no ships had hit mines in the waterway.
The latest confrontation followed a US strike in southern Iran that Iranian authorities said hit a wedding gathering, killing five people. A Reuters analysis found the damage was consistent with a direct hit by a US munition, while Washington said it was investigating and denied targeting civilians.
US President Donald Trump said on August 31 in a one-line social media post accompanied by an AI-generated video that Kharg Island was being "blown to smithereens." Iranian authorities have vowed a strong response if Kharg is attacked.
Iran is the third-largest producer in the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and exported 90% of its crude via Kharg Island before the war, but flows have been disrupted since a US blockade of Iranian oil exports began in mid-April.
Trump said on June 11 that he wanted to take over Kharg Island but then said a threatened US military operation there was off the table for now, days before Tehran and Washington signed an interim agreement aimed at ending the war on June 17.
A US attack on Kharg would heap further pressure on Iran's oil industry and its wider economy, which is already reeling from the US naval blockade.
The US imposed its blockade on Iranian ports after Iran effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway that carried one-fifth of the world's oil supply before the war.
(With input from Reuters)
(Cover: This satellite image obtained from Copernicus Sentinel Data 2026 on May 8, 2026, appears to show an oil slick spreading off the coast of Kharg Island, a key oil export terminal for Iran.

paragraphs.cn: 中国外交部长王毅周二在北京与卡塔尔首相兼外交大臣谢赫穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼举行会谈。王毅同时也是中共中央政治局委员，他表示近年来在两国领导人的战略引领下，中卡战略伙伴关系取得了长足进展。王毅指出，中国坚定支持卡塔尔维护国家主权、独立、安全与稳定，并表示相信卡塔尔将继续在涉及中国核心利益的问题上给予坚定支持。他补充说，中国是卡塔尔发展进程中最可靠、最长远的伙伴，愿与卡塔尔在国际和地区事务上保持沟通与合作。

paragraphs.en: Al Thani said that Qatar appreciates China's objective and {{21}} stance, supports China's initiatives for promoting security in the Middle East and stands ready to strengthen coordination with China to safeguard the security of global energy supply and explore a security architecture that embodies the spirit of independence.
paragraphs.cn: 阿勒萨尼表示，卡塔尔坚定恪守一个中国原则，反对外部势力干涉中国内政，愿在联合国等框架下加强与中国的沟通协调，维护多边主义，促进国际和平与共同发展。在谈及中卡能源合作时，王毅表示双方应巩固和拓展传统能源与新能源领域的合作。阿勒萨尼指出中国是卡塔尔最大的贸易和能源伙伴，并表示卡方将克服困难，优先保障对华能源供应。王毅表示，中东和海湾地区持续紧张的局势严重损害了地区国家的安全，并持续影响能源、航运和供应链的稳定。中国愿与卡塔尔及地区其他各方加强沟通协调，支持地区国家将自身前途命运牢牢掌握在自己手中，早日恢复地区和平与稳定，建立公正合理的地区安全新架构。

articles.fullText:
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, holds talks with Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Qatar Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani in Beijing, China, September 8, 2026. /Chinese Foreign Ministry
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks with Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, the prime minister and minister of foreign affairs of Qatar, in Beijing on Tuesday.
Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, said that in recent years, under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, the China-Qatar strategic partnership has made considerable progress.
Noting that China firmly supports Qatar in safeguarding its national sovereignty, independence, security and stability, Wang expressed the belief that Qatar will continue to offer firm support on issues concerning China's core interests.
He added that China is the most reliable and long-term partner in Qatar's development process and is willing to maintain communication and cooperation with Qatar on international and regional affairs.
Al Thani said Qatar firmly adheres to the one-China principle and opposes external interference in China's internal affairs and is willing to enhance communication and coordination with China under the United Nations and other frameworks, safeguard multilateralism and promote international peace and common development.
On energy cooperation between China and Qatar, Wang said both sides should consolidate and expand cooperation in both traditional and new energy sectors.
Noting that China is Qatar's largest trading and energy partner, Al Thani said the Qatari side will overcome difficulties to prioritize ensuring energy supplies to China.
Wang said the ongoing tensions in the Middle East and the Gulf region are severely undermining the security of regional countries and continuously impacting energy, shipping and supply-chain stability.
China stands ready to step up communication and coordination with Qatar and other parties in the region and supports regional countries in holding their own future and destiny firmly in their hands, restoring regional peace and stability at an early date, and establishing a just and equitable new regional security architecture.
Al Thani said that Qatar appreciates China's objective and impartial stance, supports China's initiatives for promoting security in the Middle East and stands ready to strengthen coordination with China to safeguard the security of global energy supply and explore a security architecture that embodies the spirit of independence.

阿勒萨尼表示，卡塔尔坚定恪守一个中国原则，反对外部势力干涉中国内政，愿在联合国等框架下加强与中国的沟通协调，维护多边主义，促进国际和平与共同发展。在谈及中卡能源合作时，王毅表示双方应巩固和拓展传统能源与新能源领域的合作。阿勒萨尼指出中国是卡塔尔最大的贸易和能源伙伴，并表示卡方将克服困难，优先保障对华能源供应。王毅表示，中东和海湾地区持续紧张的局势严重损害了地区国家的安全，并持续影响能源、航运和供应链的稳定。中国愿与卡塔尔及地区其他各方加强沟通协调，支持地区国家将自身前途命运牢牢掌握在自己手中，早日恢复地区和平与稳定，建立公正合理的地区安全新架构。

阿勒萨尼表示，卡塔尔赞赏中国客观公正的立场，支持中国促进中东安全的倡议，愿加强与中国的协调，共同维护全球能源供应安全，并探索体现独立精神的安全架构。

articles.fullText:
Residents and frontline workers participate in an Ebola outbreak awareness campaign in Beni, North Kivu province, eastern DR Congo, August 21, 2026. /CFP
The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and its partners have unveiled an updated 180-day multi-sectoral response plan to intensify efforts against the ongoing Ebola outbreak, with funding needs estimated at $1.3 billion.
With support from the World Health Organization (WHO), the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and other partners, the plan intends to serve as the operational roadmap for the response over the next six months.
According to the WHO Regional Office for Africa, the outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus had reached 6,342 reported cases and 3,072 deaths as of September 2. It has spread to 60 health zones across six provinces.
Health authorities are particularly concerned that a large proportion of deaths continue to occur in communities, often among people who had not previously been identified as contacts and had not reached health facilities before dying.
"Every case detected too late, every contact missed and every delay in mobilizing resources translates into lives lost," Anne Ancia, acting WHO representative in the DRC, said, calling for rapid and coordinated action on a larger scale.
DRC Health Minister Roger Kamba said containing the outbreak required efforts beyond the health sector, involving communities, government agencies, partners and donors.
"The government is fully mobilized to protect every Congolese," Kamba said.
According to the WHO, full implementation of the revised plan would require an estimated $1.3 billion.
Damien Mama, United Nations resident coordinator in the DRC, said the Ebola response needed to be integrated into the broader humanitarian effort and supported by sufficient, flexible and predictable funding.
The Africa CDC also pledged continued support for national response efforts, including resource mobilization, coordination with partners and greater involvement of communities.
The current outbreak, officially declared in May, has become the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC to date.
